text: in the studio there is a persistant player scale overlay that has finally got to go, well, not that you need to delete it but you need to make it default off and a toggle on state. also, while you are at it, go ahead and give us a proper measurement tooling and overlays so that we can be less blind about sizes.

events.text: Implemented default-off Player Scale and Measurements view toggles; native bounds precedence is selection > focused scope > model, with AABB and X/Y/Z labels in metres plus 16u-per-metre units. Passed test-stage-scale, test-mesh-edit, test-scene3d-mesh-drag, 26/26 editor command tests, and dev-scene3d-module ReleaseFast build. Full editor TS bundle passes; native ship is presently blocked by unrelated framework/skeleton/character_hashes.zig const-pointer compilation in concurrent work.
